newsitem.title: UK: Shell may declare force majeure on Nigerian export.
newsitem.headline: Shell may declare force majeure on Nigerian export.

text.p: Shell oil output has been cut by 210,000 barrels per day (bpd) in Nigeria and the company may declare force majuere from April 2 on loadings from Forcados, a senior source at Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation said on Thursday.
"Shell has advised us that there is every possibility" that they will declare force majuere from April 2, the source said.
Shell said that output has been cut by 210,000 bpd from the Forcados and Bonny fields, he said.
If force majuere is declared it would "push back cargoes in the first two decades," he said.
In addition to the cut in output from Shell the source said that Chevron have had to shut in about 300,000 bpd of output at the Escravos field.
